disclaimer: A VM marked eligible does not make the whole deployment free. Account eligibility, offer duration, usage limits, images, disks, registries, public IP addresses, and network traffic can still incur charges.

sources.title: Track your Free Tier usage for Amazon EC2
Unlimited mode for burstable performance instances

conditions: For accounts created before July 15, 2025, the EC2 offer lasts 12 months and includes t2.micro or t3.micro within usage limits.
For accounts created on or after July 15, 2025, the Free Plan lasts 6 months or until credits are depleted and includes the documented newer SKU set.
The AMI must also be Free Tier eligible.
T3 Unlimited CPU usage can incur additional charges above the baseline.
Use the EC2 free-tier-eligible API filter to verify current regional availability before launch.

sources.title: Create free services with an Azure free account
Avoid charges with your Azure free account

conditions: The VM offer is available to eligible new customers for 12 months.
The allowance is 750 hours per month for each listed VM type.
The SKU must be available in the selected region.
Unused monthly quantities do not roll over and usage beyond the allowance is billed after upgrading to pay as you go.
The separate USD 200 trial credit expires after 30 days.

gcp.program: Google Cloud Free Tier for Compute Engine

sources.title: Free Google Cloud features and trial offer

conditions: The allowance is one non-preemptible e2-micro equivalent per month across eligible regions, measured by aggregate running time.
Only us-west1, us-central1, and us-east1 are eligible.
The offer includes 30 GB-months of standard persistent disk and 1 GB of outbound data transfer from North America, subject to documented destination exclusions.
GPUs and TPUs are not included.
